title: CreateMachineRequest
description: Request body for creating or updating a Fly Machine.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the Machine.

region.description: The three-letter region code where the Machine should be deployed. If omitted, Fly.io chooses the nearest available region.

skip_service_registration.description: When true, the Machine is created without being added to the load balancer. Useful for blue-green deployments.
